# Sofascore

> > Sofascore provides live scores, H2H statistics, match predictions, and team analytics for football, table tennis, and other sports worldwide.

Sofascore is a comprehensive sports tracking platform offering real-time match data, head-to-head results, lineups, and detailed statistics across multiple sports including football (soccer), table tennis, and various other competitions. The platform covers matches from professional leagues to club friendlies across global competitions.

## Key Topics

- Live scores and real-time match tracking
- Head-to-head (H2H) statistics and historical results
- Football match coverage and predictions
- Table tennis Liga Pro and international competitions
- Team statistics and performance analytics
- Match lineups and player information
- Club Friendly Games tracking
- Match predictions and betting insights
- Multi-sport coverage (football, table tennis, etc.)
- Global sports competitions (Russia, Georgia, international)
